title: Braised Pork Ragu with Herbs
description: A hearty Italian-inspired pork ragu made with tender braised meat, fresh herbs, and a hint of zesty flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the pork cubes on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the zesty Italian seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the red wine and bring to a boil.
Return the browned pork to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the oven and braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the braised pork over pasta or polenta, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
